Spray Dried Muskmelon Powder for Beverage, Dairy and Confectionery Makers

Tradenest Naturals supplies spray dried muskmelon powder to food and beverage manufacturers, blenders and private label brands. The powder captures the soft aroma and mild sweetness of ripe melon in a dry, free-flowing form. It dissolves readily, so it is simple to dose on a production line. We supply wholesale muskmelon powder for regular manufacturing runs and smaller lots for product trials, starting from an MOQ of 5 Kg.

Advanced Manufacturing Process

Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. Ripe muskmelons are washed, peeled and pulped, and the juice is concentrated before drying. The liquid is then atomized into a stream of hot air in a spray dryer, which turns it into a fine, even powder within seconds. Drying is quick, which helps the powder keep its melon aroma and pale orange tone. This hands-on process knowledge is what our customers expect from a spray dried melon powder manufacturer.

Why Choose Our Muskmelon Powder?

Our dehydrated muskmelon powder gives product developers a practical way to add real fruit character. It blends well into dry mixes and disperses in liquids. For example, it mixes into drinks without leaving a gritty layer at the bottom of the glass. As a muskmelon powder exporter, we pack every order for long sea or air journeys and support buyers with export documentation. Our bulk muskmelon powder is produced to the same specification each time, which helps you keep taste and color steady across batches.

Technical Specifications and Quality Assurance

Clear specifications make B2B buying easier. Our spray dried cantaloupe powder (muskmelon) is checked in-house for moisture and particle size before packing. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Typical values for the standard grade are:
  • Processing: Spray dried.
  • Mesh Size: 80-100 mesh.
  • Moisture Content: Less than 5%.
  • Shelf Life: 18-24 months in sealed packs stored cool and dry.
  • Solubility: Readily soluble in water and milk bases.
Full composition details, including any drying carrier, are listed on the specification sheet. This lets your team judge how our muskmelon powder for food production fits your label requirements.

Global Supply and Logistics

Looking for a dependable muskmelon powder bulk supplier? Tradenest Naturals ships worldwide from India. Packing can be bulk bags for industrial use or retail-ready pouches. OEM and private label packing is available for brands building their own fruit powder range. Our team prepares the export paperwork your forwarder and customs broker need.

Frequently Asked Questions for Buyers

What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried muskmelon powder? The MOQ is 5 Kg. This suits sampling, pilot batches and first commercial orders. Contact our sales team for a quote based on your volume. What certifications and quality standards apply? Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. What are the packaging and shelf-life options? We use moisture-resistant packing, including bulk bags and stand-up pouches. Shelf life is 18-24 months when the powder is kept sealed in a cool, dry place. What is the lead time and how do I request a sample? Lead time depends on order volume and packing. Samples are available on request. You can ask for a sample or a formal quote through our website contact form or by email.

Summary of Buyer Value

Working with Tradenest Naturals gives you a direct line to the manufacturer. We quote fair muskmelon powder price levels for each volume tier. Because we run the drying and packing ourselves, we can keep each lot close to the agreed specification. That steadiness helps you cut rework and plan production with confidence. As your volumes grow, our muskmelon powder wholesale supply can grow with them.
